scope: Standalone fixed GigaChat personal freemium backend lifecycle; no runtime actions executed during preparation.
configuration_guards: Only selected GIGACHAT_AUTH_KEY, freemium confirmation, optional CA path and three travel-provider credentials are read from the trusted native MASTER.
SOURCE .env is never read or copied; inherited credentials and arbitrary model/base URL overrides are absent from the constructed child environment.
Other LLM keys are absent and confirmation flags false; local model budget zero; no implicit fallback.
Fixed GigaChat engineering bound 1000/day, one call/run; actual vendor quota remains UNKNOWN.
Optional CA file must be an absolute native path, a regular non-symlink file and not group/world writable; no TLS-verification bypass is configured.
lifecycle_guards: Plan returns before WSL dispatch, secret reads, runtime directory creation, Docker, SQL or HTTP.
Windows runtime dispatch is fixed to the C-backed AegML-Hackathon distro.
Foreign port 8085 listeners refuse startup/stop; recorded PID ownership, start ticks, executable, argv, cwd and creator are checked.
Stopping uses the inherited verified pidfd/SIGTERM guard; no numeric-PID fallback, force kill or global stop.
Only the committed native source prepared by the root actor is used; manifest equality fences imports and process launch.
Startup performs application health/provider status reads only; it does not invoke OAuth, model listing or inference.
database_guards: Only verified otravel-db-1 with project otravel/service db labels and the owned project network/volume may be used.
Create only fixed otravel_gigachat_eval if absent; correct role/owner/connection flags, trusted own receipt and stable OID are required for reuse.
An unrecorded existing database is not adopted; a missing recorded database is not recreated.
HBA additions are restricted to the fixed database/otravel role and exact 127.0.0.1/32 plus the observed bridge client IPv4/32 using scram-sha-256.
HBA bytes are snapshotted privately via base64, preserved as an unchanged prefix, read back exactly and checked for parse errors and exact /32 rows; reload only, no PostgreSQL restart.
Initialize schema only in the own database after identity checks; pending runs block startup.
Counters before import, after import and after process startup must show zero new model calls; other database counts cannot change during import.
open: Root must install and source-pin the committed GigaChat-capable native archive.
Root config/client status contract must expose the exact fixed model and freemium_confirmed=true with paid_fallback=false.
The official CA path and actual readiness facts are qualified separately by the geo/client actors.
No running chat URL is qualified by this preparation receipt; root GO and guarded actual startup are still required.
Pure guards do not establish actual inference, harness dialogue correctness or real travel availability.
